name: p5-agent-stage
description: Big Fish Stage: a Persona 5 styled stage for DeepSeek Harness & AI character agents

scripts.build:engine: esbuild server/src/session.ts server/src/settings-store.ts server/src/characters.ts server/src/git-ops.ts server/src/voice/tts.ts server/src/adapters/registry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=electron/engine --external:electron --external:ws
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:engine
scripts.app:build: npm run build && npm run build:engine && electron electron/main.cjs
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run build:all && npx electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.start: vite build && npm --prefix server run start
